Source: https://github.com/gt-alg-kit/C2
Revision: 92c1b861456b2e5cb4085d317fc9ebb7c8e3d88e
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16104
Adapted for CoCo-trie: namespaced integration, wide integer codes, checked byte APIs, serialization, and correctness fixes.
Optional candidate-depth sampling is exposed as depth_step; its default of 1 retains exhaustive search.
Trailing whitespace normalized for repository checks.
Wide integer bit widths use at most four 64-bit leading-zero checks.
